deviations.description: Phases 1, 2, and 3 (queue-register/heartbeat/list, queue-finish/reap, queue-check) were implemented together in one coherent editing pass rather than strictly sequentially
deviations.reason: write_queue_entry() is shared infrastructure consumed by all six queue subcommands across all three phases; authoring and testing them as one coherent unit (then verifying each phase's own test cases pass) avoided a half-working intermediate state where e.g. queue-register existed with no way to archive what it created. The single consolidated test-task-lock-queue.sh suite accumulates all three phases' cases exactly as the plan directs.
